resources.string: BestFoneFinder collects location data to send this phone\'s position by SMS when someone texts BFF where, even when the app is closed or not in use.
Required. BFF needs to receive incoming SMS messages to recognize your activation command. It does not read your stored inbox. Android may grant related SMS access together.
Optional. Allow BFF to send location replies to an authorized requester. Carrier SMS charges may apply. Skipping turns off location replies.
Optional. Contacts access lets BFF apply your Contacts privacy rules. Without it, saved trusted numbers still work and everyone else uses the Anyone rules.
Optional, but recommended. Notifications let you open or stop the alarm and see when BFF is finding a location. Skipping reduces alarm recovery when background launches are blocked.
Allow location while BFF is closed

Optional. On the next screen, open Permissions → Location and choose “%1$s”. This lets BFF answer an authorized location SMS when the app is closed. You can keep approximate location. Return to BFF when finished. Skipping turns off location replies.
Show the alarm over other apps
Optional. Turn on “Display over other apps” for BFF, then return here. This helps the alarm screen appear while you are using another app. Android may still require an alarm notification.
Show the alarm on the lock screen
Optional. Allow full-screen notifications for BFF, then return here. Without this access you may need to tap a notification to open the alarm.
Keep BFF ready in the background
Optional. Allow BFF to ignore battery optimization so incoming commands are more reliable while the phone is idle. This may use additional battery. Return here after making your choice.
BFF has checked the permissions you actually granted. You can review or enable skipped permissions later in Settings → Permissions.

Lock-screen opening is off. You may need to tap the alarm notification.
